patches.value: For every real t, S_t is an isometry on every H^s, preserves reality and zero mean, and Fourier projections contract H^s norms. For mean-zero f in L2, ||Dinv f||_(H^1)+||Dinv f||_infinity<=C||f||_2. For A,B in H^1, ||A||_infinity<=C||A||_(H^1) and ||AB||_(H^1)<=C||A||_(H^1)||B||_(H^1). For mean-zero L2 f,g, ||Jop_t(f,g)||_(H^1)<=C||f||_2||g||_2; for mean-zero A,B with Dinv A in L2 and B in L2, ||Jop_t(A,B)||_2<=C||Dinv A||_2||B||_2.

For mean-zero L2 f,g, ||Bop_t(f,g)||_(H^(-pstar))<=C||f||_2||g||_2. For L2 F,G, ||Dinv Pnz(FG)||_2<=C||F||_2||G||_2. For mean-zero A, ||A||_(H^(-pstar))<=||Dinv A||_2. Constants are uniform in real t.

For smooth mean-zero f,g on [a,b], integral_a^b Bop_t(f,g)dt=(1/3)[Jop_t(f,g)]_a^b-(1/3)integral_a^b(Jop_t(f',g)+Jop_t(f,g'))dt. Jop_t(f,g)=Jop_t(g,f), and integral_I Jop_t(Bop_t(f,g),h)dt=Cop_I(f,g,h). Identities concatenate for continuous piecewise smooth inputs.
